_how_to_use: Copy this file to commands.json (setup.bat does it for you), add your own shortcuts, then restart Jarvis. Say 'open <name>' to use them. Apps can be a program name or a full path to an .exe.
_voice_help: Voice is chosen by setup.bat or change_voice.bat: windows (default) or piper:en_GB-cori-medium. Do not enter arbitrary model names.
